title: Water Leprechaun Village with crimson rain poured from rainbows
name: Water Leprechaun Village with crimson rain poured from rainbows
description: The Rainbow Sentinel can water Leprechaun Village with crimson rain poured from rainbows. The Sentinel works it under the Absolute Light-Angle Mandate, bending all gloom into harmless light at 42 and 51 degrees - a Signature tale, not a real device.
